           CERTIFICATION OF INITIAL DECISION AND OFFICIAL RECORD

                                 (Issued October 22, 2026)

1.    In accordance with Rule 708(b)(3) of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and
Procedure,1 I hereby certify my initial decision in this proceeding dated October 22,
2026.

2.     I further certify that the following constitutes the official record in this proceeding:

       a.       The official stenographer’s transcript, consisting of 59 volumes totaling
                9456 pages, including a prehearing conference conducted on May 8, 2025,
                an oral argument conducted May 21, 2025, a prehearing conference
                conducted on October 16, 2025, an oral argument conducted on November
                13, 2025, and a final prehearing conference conducted on January 9, 2026.
                I conducted the evidentiary in two portions, with the first portion of the
                hearing occurring from January 13, 2026, through February 5, 2026. The
                intermediate period between the first and second portions of the hearing
                included a mid-hearing conference on February 24, 2026, and oral
                arguments conducted on March 25, 2026, and April 6, 2026. I conducted
                the remainder of the hearing from April 8, 2026, until I concluded the
                hearing and closed the evidentiary record on June 3, 2026.
